about_the_game:
Aiden never planned to be a top student, but life had other ideas. His noble family is on the brink of bankruptcy, and the only way to save them is by earning a scholarship—one that only the class president can get. The problem? He’s not the only one after the position, and competition in this academy is fierce.

Now, Aiden must juggle classes, rivals, and academy politics while dealing with a group of unique and unpredictable girls. Some will help, some will stand in his way, and some will just drag him into even more trouble.

Meet the Girls:

💜 Violetta – A vampire and top student. Arrogant, sharp-tongued, and convinced she’s better than everyone else.

🦊 Aurora – A fox-girl from distant lands. Skilled in magic but struggles to understand human customs.

💚 Lina – A shy, sweet goblin girl. She has a crush on Aiden but is too embarrassed to admit it.

👻 Yuma – A pervy ghost who died frustrated and is always on the hunt for some fun.

⚡ Miss Morrigan – The strict, no-nonsense headmistress. She keeps the academy under tight control.

🧚 Fairy – A tiny trickster who guides Aiden. But her real motives remain a mystery.

Aiden must use his wits, charm, and a bit of luck to rise to the top. Will he outplay his rivals and claim the title of class president? Or will he get caught up in all the chaos and distractions along the way?

content_descriptors.notes: All characters depicted in this game are over the age of 21. The game contains a lot of sexual content, nudity, sexual innuendo, crude sex scenes
